meals.name: Margherita pizza
meals.art: Pizza with mozzarella patches and basil

animations.title: Grating cheese
animations.description: 1 Leo proudly holds orange cheddar block beside silver box grater on board. 2 presses cheese downward against grater, focused face. 3 pulls cheese upward ready for next stroke, visible pile of shavings below grater, happy eyes. 4 lifts small bowl of grated cheese proudly, grater rests on table.

animations.title: Stretching dough
animations.description: 1 Leo places round pale pizza dough on floured board. 2 presses dough flat with both paws. 3 lifts and stretches dough between paws into wide thin oval, comically surprised face, dough stays below chin. 4 lays round stretched dough on board with proud grin, flour on one cheek.

animations.title: Slicing mushrooms
animations.description: 1 Leo holds a brown button mushroom above chopping board, kitchen knife resting on board. 2 knife poised just over mushroom, other paw safely away. 3 knife down slicing mushroom, neat mushroom slices on board, focused smile. 4 knife rests on board, Leo holds little bowl of mushroom slices and smiles.

animations.title: Sprinkling rice
animations.description: 1 Leo holds a little wooden scoop full of uncooked rice over a small pan. 2 tilts scoop so white rice grains fall into pan, concentrating. 3 empties last grains into pan with tiny happy smile. 4 scoop rests on table, Leo stirs rice in pan using wooden spoon, delighted grin.

animations.title: Crushing garlic
animations.description: 1 Leo presents a peeled garlic clove beside small mortar and pestle on table. 2 garlic inside mortar, Leo raises wooden pestle just above mortar with determined face. 3 presses pestle down into mortar crushing garlic, little garlic bits visible, tiny effort expression. 4 Leo raises pestle slightly with garlic paste on end, smiling proudly, mortar remains on table.
